description:
Parent: fz-kdt

COLD-REVIEWED DESIGN v2 (2026-08-30): demand is derived from live edges; the
edge fact already exists.

## Measured foundation (reproduced independently by the cold reviewer)
- 304/21/325 true-preservation events; 98%/100%/82% of preserved Activation
  claims are KEY MIGRATION (same function, different arrow, same conclusion).
- preserved_analysis_claims is ~95% no-op (6,674 raw vs 304 real on 00420);
  only 50/3/37 distinct keys are ever really preserved.
- Edges are near write-once: 90%/83%/89% never change their demand set;
  112/15/62 set-level bumps over 454/75/301 edges.
- BACKWARD migration is real: measured demand sets like {816}->{845}->
  {816,845}->{845}; 7/0/3 resurrections per drive.
- Abandoned keys: 30/4/12 per drive; 29/4/10 own callsites; cascade depth >=2
  measured ZERO. ~20% of AnalyzeActivation evals land on abandoned keys.
- RETRACTION IS SELF-UNDOING TODAY: demand_fact_producer routes a retracted
  key's own analysis wait to SeedActivation (drive.rs:249-251), which
  fabricates Activation+ActivationInputs from the key's arrow -- lossy
  reconstruction, permanent rows. Preservation OFF: SeedActivation 27->73.
- CallSiteTargets (semantic.rs:47-56) IS the edge fact: stable CallSiteKey
  identity, value names the demanded callee activation; CallTargetSummary
  carries activation_inputs. activation_input_contributions duplicates it
  (same values built at jobs/semantic.rs:1210-1232 / 1286-1308).

## Story 1 -- a caller-discovered activation has exactly one producer
demand_fact_producer's Activation|ActivationInputs -> SeedActivation arm stops
answering for keys no root/latent path seeded; analyze_activation's self-gate
(jobs/semantic.rs:70-79) CONCLUDES (empty outputs, reads recorded so first
appearance re-wakes) instead of waiting. First -- nothing else is safe while
retraction is self-undoing. RED: retract a caller-discovered Activation(k);
SeedActivation(k) must never run. Instrument: preservation-OFF SeedActivation
count falls to the preserve-ON numbers (<=27/6/20).

## Story 2 -- every reached callsite publishes an edge, resolved or not
CallTargetEdge.activation gains a third state distinct from None-as-provider-
boundary (unknown-is-not-none literally: unresolved vs boundary are conflated
as absence today). Emit CallSiteSummary/Targets for every REACHED callsite;
delete those kinds' arms of preserved_analysis_claims. Acceptance: their
true-preservation 24/0/77 -> 0; Activation-kind unchanged (Story 3's);
inventory pins 59/221/214 HOLD (move = STOP); backend byte-identical;
zero-uncaused unweakened.

## Story 3 -- demand derived from live edges
Refcounted, insertion-ordered (OrderedSet) World index over edge values,
folded in complete_job's existing harvest (world.rs:463-480); ABSORBS
activation_frontier and retires the drain sort at drive.rs:439. Activation(k)
presence + ActivationInputs(k) rows derived from live edges (row budget at
the fold); DELETE activation_input_contributions, conclude/extend_activation_
input_contributions, the AnalyzeActivation half of ContributionMap, and
preserved_analysis_claims entirely. DISSOLVES fz-kdt.64. The index is a
presence arbiter, NOT a publisher -- claimants of Activation(k) remain the
caller derivations (an index-as-publisher has no reads, reads permanently
quiet, and settles the fact prematurely: the named fatal class).
Decommission on last-edge-away: a conclusion retracting the old key's own
outputs AND clearing its ActivationSlot (return_ty/analysis/ascents --
semantic.rs:608-614,:967-974) or resurrection inherits an exhausted widening
budget and publishes an unearned `any` (the fz-f98.14.11 class).
Refcount decrement-and-increment inside ONE completion; retraction only at
post-completion zero (same-conclusion migrate-away-and-back = non-event).
Edge identity stays CallSiteKey=(activation,callsite) -- (function,callsite)
conflates distinct edges and breaks materializers (jobs/artifact.rs:1216,
runtime_demand.rs:917-921, native.rs:733); a decommissioned activation's
edges decommission WITH it (same mechanism, bounded on the finite key
inventory -- property-test the bound, don't argue it).
RED x3: (a) two callers, one migrates away -> Activation(k) stays (refcount);
(b) decommissioned-then-re-demanded key publishes the same return as a fresh
mint (the ascents-reset test -- fails today by construction); (c) same-
completion migrate-away-and-back emits no retraction. Acceptance: Activation
true-preservation 256/21/171 -> 0; decommissions <= 30/4/12; cascade depth>=2
pinned 0 via telemetry; pins/byte-identity/determinism/matrix; evals ratchet
at-or-below post-kdt.63 base with decommission conclusions the sole counted
addition.

## Story 4 (conditional) -- superseded retraction is not a ground shift
scheduler.rs:537. Gate: after Story 3, measure shift-wakes attributable to
Activation retraction; if ~zero (likely: the key's only Current reader is its
own analysis, now concluding undemanded), DELETE this story rather than build.

## Sequencing
Land before the parked fz-kdt.13.2: with every reached callsite emitting an
edge, 13.2's withdraw-unreported-derivations footgun stops being a footgun
(every callsite derivation re-reported by construction). Does NOT shrink
fz-kdt.68 (the caller<->callee 2-cycle and job-wide wait dirtying remain).

## Superseded text
The v1 'CalleeDemand' proposal and its conclusion-based decommission story are
superseded: the fact exists (CallSiteTargets), and the load-bearing changes
are the producer-map fix and the undemanded-conclusion, not presence->content.

## CHILDREN

- [ ] fz-kdt.69.1 P1 A caller-discovered activation has exactly one producer

## UNBLOCKS

- ○ fz-kdt.13.2 P1 analyze_activation reports derivations by read watermark
- ○ fz-kdt.74 P1 Coalesce analysis identity at name/arity: dispatch-class roots, value identity at settlement

## Story 3 addenda from fz-kdt.69.1's review (binding)
- TRIPWIRE: the state (Activation(k) absent AND ActivationInputs(k) has a
  publisher) currently has NO producer (seed refuses -- correct) and is
  unreachable today (swept: 0 refusals across matrix+lib). Story 3's
  decommission makes it reachable; land a counted tripwire (telemetry or
  debug_assert) on the refusal path WITH Story 3 so the assumption is
  measured, not remembered.
- The runtime-demand frontier mints activations with NO edge fact naming them
  (fz-kdt.69.1 origin A: 27/2/20 per drive, no Executable fact either). The
  live-edge index must model these as a second legitimate demand source
  (root/latent seeds), not force them through edges.
- analyze_activation's ActivationInputs gate (jobs/semantic.rs:87) measured
  ZERO fires across fixtures+lib -- likely unrepresentable (all three minters
  publish both facts together); confirm and collapse to one gate in Story 3
  (rip-out law).
title: A preserved claim keeps its claim but loses its subscriptions
